en: A black‑and‑white postcard view over a wide river toward a historic European city skyline. A long bridge with vehicles and pedestrians crosses the water toward a waterfront lined with multi‑storey buildings. Dominating the skyline are two tall church towers with spires. The lower left of the white border contains the printed caption "Rīga." and there is a small printer's mark and number on the lower right border.
